## This release

See which Git worktrees hold work before you remove them. RillDisk can ask your own
`git`, read-only, whether each linked worktree has uncommitted or untracked changes,
commits that exist only on a detached HEAD, or a lock, and when work last happened.
Clean up shows the verdict on every worktree card, **Select clean idle worktrees**
ticks only worktrees with no Git-reported changes and no recent work, and removal
asks Git again right before each worktree is moved. Worktrees stay Review first:
Git does not see ignored files or running agents. The CLI does the same with
`rilldisk reclaim --git`. The MCP server does not run Git.

Cleanup now also refuses a different folder created at a candidate's path after the
scan, and what removal frees is always stated on disk ("at least" only when every
allocation is known). The desktop gains Show in Explorer on every right-click menu, a quieter
sidebar with the version and update check at the bottom, an update card instead of
the bottom bar, a scan-limit setting with a bounded rescan when a scan stops at
its entry limit, and a worktree inventory with clear scope.

Scan speed is unchanged. See [release notes, evidence and known limits](https://github.com/lord007tn/rilldisk/blob/{tag}/docs/RELEASE-0.1.3.md).
